paragraphs: Sasson. A certain sectarian (min) in the time of R' Abahu. [Sukkah 48b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.48b.6).[^1]

notes.text: Sasson is the sectarian who addresses Rabbi Abahu in the linked exchange. They use the word sasson (joy) in different ways to read the same verse.
